name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: The official store of add-ons for the Cursor AI coding tool — things like Gmail, Salesforce, and GitHub connectors that plug straight into your coding assistant.
buyer: Not an independent buyer opportunity — this is Cursor's own first-party plugin catalog, built and owned by the Cursor company.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company builds and submits its own official Cursor plugin (like the Salesforce or Gong ones already listed) to reach developers inside their coding tool.
A dev-tools consultancy offers to build a custom internal Cursor plugin for an enterprise's proprietary systems.
A freelance developer builds a niche third-party plugin (e.g. for a smaller SaaS) to get distribution through Cursor's marketplace.

money_ideas.idea: A SaaS vendor builds a free plugin here purely as a lead-gen/retention channel for their paid product.

steal_this: Pick a SaaS tool you already use that has no Cursor plugin yet, build a thin wrapper plugin this weekend, and use it to get warm intros to that company.
